column1: # Copy this file to mapping.tsv (which git ignores) and replace the references with your own.
# Secret name <TAB> where it goes <TAB> required <TAB> 1Password secret reference
#   where:     github  pushed to the GitHub environment by "with-op.sh github-sync", and exported by "with-op.sh --"
#              local   only exported by "with-op.sh --", never pushed to GitHub
#   reference: op://<vault>/<item>/<field>   (in 1Password: right-click a field, "Copy Secret Reference")
# A reference is a pointer, not a secret, but it shows how the vault is organised. Keep mapping.tsv out of git.
